about.description: AGVT is a receipt-token-style vault share for the AgriDex Trade Float Vault on Stellar/Soroban (consumer brand: Loam). Holders deposit USDC. Capital is deployed into short-duration commodity trade-finance exposures (the "Aniseed" series references aniseed-linked trade receivables). The vault is operated by AgriDex International Limited and uses a permissioned/approved-wallet onboarding flow per official docs. Returns accrue at the vault level through NAV growth. Receipt-token balances are constant while per-token value increases as underlying trade-finance cashflows realize. Target APY 9-12% (per docs). 30-day minimum holding period. Two-phase redemption (request to notice period to confirm) processed at par value subject to available liquidity. Underlying exposures: short-duration trade receivables, pre-financing of verified trade flows, inventory-linked structures, and settlement/payments float. NO third-party audit / proof-of-reserves of the loan book exists at audit date (per issuer submission). The on-chain exchange contract (CATKU4.IRN5N) is the sole minter/burner and holds the USDC reserve used for redemption. The rate is operator-controlled, which is an explicit centralization vector. Contract deployed May 11, 2026. Distinct from the Solana-based AGRI governance token (which is a separate AgriDex product).
